scenario_description:
Objective: Make next Tuesday’s Union Station layover easier while the Joliet inspection and return ride remain workable without added arrangements.
Emerging Need: A short sponsor walkthrough near the station creates a chance to avoid hauling the field roller through a cramped detour only if a day-cubby board is open.
Decision Context: The useful choice depends on combining the rail receipt, the walkthrough timing, the posted cubby window, and stored Union Station cubby rules.
Consequence: Timely use would add hands-free convenience during the stop; missing the export simply leaves ordinary carry-along travel unchanged.

parameter.title: Joliet scrimmage field inspection

parameter.content: For Jan 20, our Canal Lab has a 14:25-15:05 badge-printer bench walkthrough two blocks east of Union Station. Stop-by only, no RSVP, fine to skip; the bench aisle is tight when visitors bring loose bags.

parameter.subject: Canal day-cubby board opened for January 20
parameter.body: The January 20 Canal Street day-cubby board is open. Two standard cubbies remain for afternoon rail travelers; email holds accepted until the 13:00 export today with the ticket reference and item label.

parameter.subject: Canal day-cubby board exported for January 20
parameter.body: The 13:00 export for January 20 Canal Street day-cubby holds has run. Any unheld standard cubbies are now walk-up only on the travel day.
